reviews.text: Ordered in from this place and their kheema biryani was authentic and tasty. Quantity was good and the food was fresh. It was authentically Hyderabadi as well. Enjoyed the spices and the flavours

Recently ordered a Special Chicken Biryani from this restaurant. The taste was good, it has chicken kebabs with spicy gravy kept over biryani. Packing was very good. Got it with Raita, Salan and Onion salad.\n\nthedelighttable.wordpress.com

This is a trip one should definitely not miss. Heard good feedback from a friend about chicken keema biryani and tried it on the first opportunity. Delivered in a cute little pack and neat bowl the biryani was a good surprise. Well chopped chicken keema on top of biryani rice....
